correctness.rationale: For a prefix ending at target level u, the common upper bounds of the previous source level are exactly the higher target levels if at least two distinct points of B_u were used, and are those levels plus the unique used point of B_u in the singleton case. This proves the two-state sufficiency and gives exactly x_{u,j} versus x_{u,j}+1. The unchanged-top transition can occur only from a singleton state and contributes the carry S_j. Summing terminal states partitions all monotone maps. I independently replayed all 225 source-target weak-order composition pairs of total size at most four against brute force and recovered the four larger transfer anchors 44, 738, 143, and 17.
risks: \(O(hk^2)\) is an arithmetic-operation count, not bit complexity.
